tenderSchedule.title: Providing and supplying of food and other arrangements on occasion of Utsava Samithi Dasara 2026 organised by Shivamogga City Corporation
tenderSchedule.description: Providing and supplying of food and other arrangements on occasion of Utsava Samithi Dasara 2026 organised by Shivamogga City Corporation

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the tenderer should be inclusive of all taxes.
For detailed specification refer to attached detailed estimation.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company registration certificate
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender,from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 years

Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service in any state level dasara event, in any one of last five financial years, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number

itemList.itemName: To capture photos and videos of the Dasara inauguration, the Dasara festival procession, and the Banni Mudiyuva (Banni tree worship) ceremony, and to provide the output in an album and on a video pen drive. (The task must be executed efficiently in accordance with the directions and instructions of the Dasara Festival Committee Chairperson and Member Secretary.).
Providing and supplying of good quality (White /colour) cotton dhoti (2m length). .
Providing and supplying of good quality single line arecanut garland. .
Providing and supplying of good quality cotton shawl (white / colour) of size (2.5x6)ft. .

Supplying of good quality Fruit basket (Bamboo basket covered with net cloth) containing any five types of fruits weighing 2kg for dignitaries along with recyclable carry bag inclusive of cost of packing, transportation etc. as directed by the officer in charge of the work. .
Providing and supplying of Dry fruits gift box (app. 150 gms including Badam, cashwenut, raisins, pista). .
Providing and supplying of Chow Chow Bath with kesari bath, Upma and tea/coffee/badam milk (food shall be served in areca plate along with drinking water in paper cups). .
Providing and supplying of Kinley / Bisleri / Kingfisher / Signature mineral water bottle (1/2 Ltr). .
Supplying of 20 litre water can with dispenser. .

Providing and supplying of Kayi holige with ghee/ Bele holige with ghee, White Rice along with Vegetable Sambar, Rasam,Curd, Palya, Split green gram Kosambari, any bajji (Chilli / Banana / Heerekayi / Onion / Potato) and Pickle (food shall be served in areca plate along with drinking water in paper cups). .

Providing and supplying of Chapati-2 nos and sagu + chutney / Poori+kurma / any rice bath, White Rice along with Vegetable Sambar, Rasam, Curd, Palya, Dry sweet(Jamoon/Burfi), any bajji (Chilli / Banana / Heerekayi / Onion / Potato), papad and Pickle (food shall be served in areca plate along with drinking water in paper cups). .
Providing and supplying of Bisi Bele Bath/ Khara Pongal with Chutney and Vada-1No, Kara Boondi and tea/coffee/badam milk (food shall be served in areca plate along with drinking water in paper cups).
